title: Browser Boxing Version 2.0 is live: in game money, betting on fights, and a shop
author: boxing-boxing
selftext:
My free browser boxing game just got in game money, betting, and a shop. Version 2.0 is live.

The currency is called Bucks. Fighters earn them from fight purses, a first win of the day bonus, Career, awards, and events, and they cannot be bought or cashed out. The Shop has 461 items (clothing, gloves, hats, tattoos, card backgrounds) plus 12 new taunts, with a fitting room so you can try a whole look on your boxer before you buy. Betting is Bucks on Ranked fights before the opening bell: winner, finish round, total knockdowns, plus equal side bets between fighters. Play money only.

On the AI side, since that is what this sub is for: the code is mine, I am a staff software engineer by trade, and the new systems in this update are hand built. Where GenAI sits in this game is the content layer. It writes the in game fight summaries from real fight data, so a knockout in round 2 reads as a story about that specific fight instead of a template line, and it helped with the artwork, including a lot of the catalog art that now sits in the shop. Version 2.0 made that split more obvious: the systems got bigger and stayed hand built, while the AI touched parts (summaries, item art) are the parts players read and look at.

Curious how others here draw that line. Do you keep AI strictly in the content layer too, or have you let it into systems work and not regretted it?

Free, no download, tutorial first then players or NPCs: [https://browserboxing.com](https://browserboxing.com)
